label: Matches
description: Premier League matches played in the selection.

label: Wins
description: Matches won. Actual result, not expected.

label: Draws
description: Matches drawn. Actual result.

label: Losses
description: Matches lost. Actual result.

label: Points
description: Actual league points: 3 per win + 1 per draw.

label: Goals for
description: Goals scored, including opposition own goals. Actual, always a whole number.

label: Goals against
description: Goals conceded, including own goals by Liverpool players. Actual.

label: Goal difference
description: Goals for minus goals against. Actual.

label: Clean sheets
description: Matches in which Liverpool conceded no goals. Actual.

label: xG (expected)
description: Expected goals: the sum of the xG of every shot Liverpool took. Expected, not actual goals. Shot-level Understat model.

label: xGA (expected)
description: Expected goals against: the sum of the xG of every shot Liverpool conceded. Lower is better.

label: xG difference (expected)
description: xG minus xGA. Expected, not actual.

label: npxG (expected)
description: Expected goals excluding penalties.

label: xPts (xG simulation)
description: Expected points from the shot-level xG simulation: each shot is an independent Bernoulli trial with p = its xG, goal totals are convolved exactly and P(win), P(draw) give 3P(W) + P(D). Expected, not actual.

label: Market-expected points
description: Expected points from de-vigged closing betting odds: 3 x P(win) + 1 x P(draw). Expected, not actual.

label: Goals minus xG
description: Actual goals scored by Liverpool players (own goals excluded) minus expected goals. Positive means finishing above expectation.

label: Points minus xPts
description: Actual points minus xG-simulated expected points.

label: Points minus market expectation
description: Actual points minus market-expected points. Positive means results beat the market.

label: Points per match
description: Actual points divided by matches played.

label: Goals per match
description: Actual goals scored per match.

label: Goals against per match
description: Actual goals conceded per match.

label: xG per match (expected)
description: Mean expected goals for per match.

label: xGA per match (expected)
description: Mean expected goals against per match. Lower is better.

label: xG difference per match (expected)
description: Mean of xG minus xGA per match.

label: Rolling 10-match xG difference
description: Average xG difference (xG minus xGA) per match over the latest 10 matches, current match included. Expected, not actual. Needs at least 10 matches in the selection.

label: npxG per match (expected)
description: Mean non-penalty expected goals per match.

label: Shots per match
description: Mean shots taken per match (own goals excluded).

label: Shots conceded per match
description: Mean shots faced per match. Lower is better.

label: xG per shot
description: Mean of per-match xG divided by shots: average shot quality.

label: PPDA
description: Passes allowed per defensive action in the opposition 40% of the pitch. Lower means a more intense press, so lower is treated as better.

label: Deep completions per match
description: Passes completed within roughly 20 yards of the opposition goal (excluding crosses), per match.

label: Deep completions allowed per match
description: Opposition deep completions per match. Lower is better.

label: Open-play xG per match
description: xG from open-play shots per match (excludes set pieces, corners, free kicks and penalties).

label: Open-play xGA per match
description: xG conceded from open-play shots per match.

label: Set-piece xGA per match
description: xG conceded from corners, indirect and direct free kicks and set pieces per match (penalties excluded).

label: xG per shot (pooled)
description: Total xG divided by total shots over the selection: average shot quality, comparable with league clubs (own goals excluded).

label: Shot map
description: Every Liverpool shot in the selection, drawn on a 105 x 68 m pitch attacking left to right. Circle size grows with the shot xG; filled red circles are goals. Own goals are not shots and are not drawn.

label: Shots conceded map
description: Every shot Liverpool faced. Opposition coordinates are flipped so that Liverpool defend the left goal and attack left to right, as on the attack map. Circle size grows with xG; filled red circles are goals conceded from shots.

label: Shot volume vs shot quality
description: Shots per match against xG per shot (pooled) for each club in the league, with Liverpool highlighted and dashed league averages. Up and to the right means more and better chances.

label: Threat source mix
description: Share of Liverpool xG by source: open play, set pieces (corners, indirect and direct free kicks) and penalties.

label: Open play vs set piece xGA
description: xG conceded per match split into open play, set pieces (corners, indirect and direct free kicks) and penalties. Lower is better.

label: xG per match trend
description: Expected goals (bars) against actual goals (dots) in each match, with a rolling 10-match average of xG.

label: xGA per match trend
description: Expected goals conceded (bars) against actual goals conceded (dots) in each match, with a rolling 10-match average and the league average per match.

label: Appearances
description: Matches in which the player played at least one minute.

label: Squad table
description: Every Liverpool player with minutes in the selection. Per-90 values divide the total by minutes played and multiply by 90, so they are only shown as reliable above the minimum-minutes filter. Click a column to sort and a player to open the profile.

label: Role leaders
description: The top three players for five roles using only the data available: Finisher (npG minus npxG), Shot Threat (npxG per 90), Creator (xA per 90), Build-up (xGBuildup per 90) and Involvement (xGChain per 90), among players above the minimum-minutes filter.

label: Season-over-season trends
description: The player metric in every Premier League season. Hollow points mark seasons below the minimum minutes, where per-90 rates are unreliable.

label: Player comparison
description: Two players side by side for the current selection. Bars share one scale within each row.

label: xG race
description: Cumulative expected goals for each team over the match, minute by minute. Steps are shots; filled markers are goals (actual), including own goals credited to the other team.

label: Match shot map
description: Both teams shots on one 105 x 68 m pitch. Liverpool attack left to right and the opposition shots are rotated to attack the other way. Circle size grows with xG; filled circles are goals.

label: Market vs xG-simulated probabilities
description: Liverpool win/draw/loss probabilities before the match from the closing betting odds with the margin removed (proportional and Shin methods), next to the exact simulation from this match shots. The simulation uses what actually happened in the match: it is a post-match view of the chances, not a forecast.

label: Points: actual vs expected
description: For each season, actual league points next to xG-simulated expected points and market-expected points. Seasons with fewer than 10 matches are left out of the chart.

label: Results vs market expectation
description: Running total of actual points minus market-expected points over the selection. Rising means results are beating what the closing odds implied; shaded stretches are the mispriced runs.

label: Mispriced runs
description: Stretches where 10 consecutive matches returned at least 4 points more or fewer than the closing odds implied (actual points minus market-expected points). Overlapping windows of the same sign are merged into one run.

label: Calibration scores
description: Brier score and log loss of the market probabilities and the xG-simulated probabilities on the selected matches, next to a naive forecast that always predicts the selection own win, draw and loss rates. The xG simulation is built from the match shots, so it describes the chances rather than forecasting them.

label: Reliability plot
description: Forecast probability against how often the outcome happened. Every match contributes three points (win, draw, loss), grouped into probability bins. On the dashed diagonal, forecasts are perfectly calibrated. Larger markers mean more outcomes in the bin.

label: Every match: market vs xG simulation
description: For each match, the closing-odds win probability and the xG-simulated win probability, with the actual result shown along the top.

label: Flat-stake cumulative P&L
description: Running profit of a hypothetical 1-unit stake on Liverpool to win every match at the closing odds. Retrospective analysis, not a strategy.

label: Flat-stake ROI by season
description: Profit divided by the number of 1-unit stakes for each season. Retrospective analysis, not a strategy: a season is a small sample of about 38 bets.

label: External model
description: Optional probabilities from your own model, supplied as a CSV with a match key and home, draw and away probabilities. When present they are scored with the same Brier score and log loss as the market and the xG simulation.

label: Win rate
description: Share of matches won.

label: Clean-sheet rate
description: Share of matches without conceding.

label: Market P(win)
description: Liverpool win probability from closing odds with the overround removed.

label: xG-sim P(win)
description: Liverpool win probability from the exact xG simulation.

label: Bookmaker margin
description: Sum of inverse odds minus 1 on the closing 1X2 market.

label: Brier score (market)
description: Mean over matches of the sum of squared errors of the three outcome probabilities. Lower is better; a fixed 1/3 forecast scores 0.667.

label: Brier score (xG sim)
description: Brier score of the xG-simulated probabilities.

label: Log loss (market)
description: Mean negative log probability assigned to the actual result. Lower is better; a fixed 1/3 forecast scores 1.099.

label: Log loss (xG sim)
description: Log loss of the xG-simulated probabilities.

label: Brier score (external model)
description: Brier score of an optional external model supplied by CSV (see README).

label: Log loss (external model)
description: Log loss of an optional external model supplied by CSV.

label: Flat-stake P&L (units)
description: Retrospective profit of a hypothetical 1-unit stake on Liverpool to win every match at the closing odds. Analysis only, not a strategy.

label: Flat-stake ROI
description: P&L divided by units staked (one per match). Retrospective analysis, not a strategy.

label: Closing odds (Liverpool win)
description: Decimal closing price on a Liverpool win: Pinnacle where available, else market average.

label: Minutes
description: Minutes played in Premier League matches.

label: Goals
description: Goals scored (no own goals). Actual.

label: Non-penalty goals
description: Goals scored excluding penalties. Actual.

label: Assists
description: Assists. Actual.

label: xG (expected)
description: Sum of xG of the player shots. Expected.

label: npxG (expected)
description: Sum of non-penalty xG of the player shots. Expected.

label: xA (expected)
description: Expected assists: the xG of shots the player passes created. Expected.

label: npG minus npxG
description: Non-penalty goals minus non-penalty xG. Positive means finishing above expectation (Finisher role).

label: xG per 90
description: xG per 90 minutes played.

label: npxG per 90
description: Non-penalty xG per 90 minutes (Shot Threat role).

label: xA per 90
description: Expected assists per 90 minutes (Creator role).

label: xGBuildup per 90
description: xG of possessions the player was involved in, excluding shots and key passes, per 90 (Build-up role).

label: xGChain per 90
description: xG of every possession the player was involved in, per 90 (Involvement role).

label: Shots per 90
description: Shots per 90 minutes.

label: Key passes per 90
description: Passes leading directly to a shot, per 90 minutes.
